gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anuphan: Technical in spirit, Nulshock stretches its capitals wide and traces every stroke as a single unshaded outline. And Anuphan, with big round bowls and open curves, gives that stiffness something soft to lean on.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-arimo: Arimo takes the text work, its tall mean line and gapped rounded letters staying quiet and plain. Arimo lets Nulshock be the loud one, a neon-tube outline stretched wide with generous spacing.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-armata: Nulshock stretches wide with generous tracking, and with no hairlines at all, every stem matches its thinnest part. Armata is the one for steady text, its lowercase filling most of the letter height.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-athiti: Wide, stretched capitals drawn like sign-shop vinyl cut to one line width give Nulshock its character. But Athiti is friendlier, with a see-through gap in each s and a mean line set high.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Wire-thin and wide, Nulshock stretches its outline letters out with generous tracking. It makes the loud entrance; Atkinson Hyperlegible does the careful work, with clearly set s terminals.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters out like stencil bridges pulled open, with counters that breathe. And Nulshock matches that spaciousness, though its pencil-line stretched outline is far more technical and bold.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-biryani: Nulshock is stretched, bold and technical. Biryani keeps text friendly over many lines, with a large clear eye on every e and counters that never clog.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-blinker: Stretched wide with its capitals barely above the lowercase, Nulshock draws a steady unshaded outline. Blinker reads easily below, its lines holding their thickness and its apertures open.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-carrois-gothic: Modern and sharp, Nulshock stretches wide with a crossbar on its t matching the stem in weight. Carrois Gothic is the steadier voice, its high-set x-height and open c making text easy going.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC keeps capitals and lowercase nearly level, and each curve ends in a clear opening. Nulshock is the showpiece, stretched wide in unvarying line thickness, while the body does the quiet work.
